# Your Own World (YOW)

> Your Own World (YOW) is an all-in-one creative writing and worldbuilding platform. It keeps a writer's manuscript, characters, relationships, family trees, lore, locations, maps, timelines and story outline in one connected workspace. It runs in a web browser, with a desktop app for Lifetime customers. It is made by an independent UK developer.

Facts below are kept in step with the live site. Prices are in GBP. If anything here conflicts with the pages linked below, the pages are correct.

## What it is for

- Novelists, fantasy and science-fiction authors, comic/graphic novel writers, and tabletop game masters who want their world and their manuscript in one place.
- Project types: novels, novellas, short stories, comic/graphic novels, 5E campaigns, and system-neutral tabletop campaigns.
- It is not a screenplay or stage-play tool, and phone/tablet use is not officially supported (designed for laptop/desktop, in a browser or the desktop app).

## Pricing (see the pricing page for current terms)

- Free: one editable project with the full writing and worldbuilding toolkit (including the map builder) and 250 MB storage. No card required. AI tools are paid-only.
- Monthly: £10 per month. Unlimited projects in the browser and Cloud sync while subscribed. Cancel any time. Does not include the desktop app.
- Lifetime: £75 one-time (£50 for the first 100 customers, who also get Founder status). Unlimited projects, permanent desktop and offline access, and Cloud included for one year (two for Founders), then optional at £6 per year.
- AI features use the customer's own OpenRouter or OpenAI API key on a paid plan; YOW does not resell AI usage.
- The desktop app is not yet signed or notarized by Apple or Microsoft, so a one-time OS warning appears on first launch.
